subject: Next step: ML/Infra technical deep dive (60-90m) — scheduling & scope
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Morris <jenna.morris@acromed.com>, Alex Fu <alex.fu@acromed.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acromed.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 4 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick post-call recap + propose ML/Infra deep dive (60-90m)

Hi Jenna / Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning — good to hear more about AcroMed's latency targets for clinical inference and the planned timeline for the pilot. Quick recap from our side:

- Goal: validate end-to-end inference latency and cost at 1–3 req/sec per model while preserving PHI-safe controls for telemetry.
- Primary evaluation: 90-day pilot across 2 endpoints, one batch & one streaming.
- Security: you mentioned the security team will want a short segment on audit logs + data isolation.

Next step we recommend: a focused ML/Infra technical deep dive (60–90 minutes) with our infra & serving engineers to:
1) walk your ML stack and model footprint,
2) run through network/private deployment options and SSO/KMS,
3) align on benchmarks, rollout plan, and mutual action items.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Jul 14 — 11:00–12:30 (PT) — 90m
- Wed Jul 15 — 14:00–15:30 (PT) — 90m
- Fri Jul 17 — 09:00–10:30 (PT) — 90m

Ask: please confirm which slot works and who from your side will attend (ML lead, infra/ops, security). If none of the above fit, share 2–3 times and we'll match.

I attached the discovery notes we captured for reference (short). Also linking a one-page agenda draft in the follow-up.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0123

Attachment: 2026-07-04_discovery-notes.pdf

From: Jenna Morris <jenna.morris@acromed.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 4 Jul 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick post-call recap + propose ML/Infra deep dive (60-90m)

Thanks, Soojin —

Appreciate the recap. We're keen to do this deep dive. Short answers:
- Attendees from our side: Alex Fu (CTO), Priya Shah (Lead ML).
- Security will likely send Miguel Torres (Head of IT Security) but he needs a firm invite.
- Of the proposed slots, Wed Jul 15 14:00 PT looks promising; Friday morning could also work but prefer Wed.

One item: Miguel will want to see what level of audit logs / retention you can provide and any SOC 2 evidence. Can you have someone cover that?

If you can pencil Wed Jul 15 14:00 PT for 90 minutes and send an agenda + meeting link, we'll confirm with Miguel.

—Jenna
Jenna Morris
Head of Clinical AI Programs, AcroMed
jenna.morris@acromed.com

Grace / Ben —

Thanks — I can handle scheduling and the invite.
Soojin
